name: kiwiply-monorepo
description: Kiwiply monorepo root — npm workspaces. `web/` joined as a workspace member in W1.3 to consume @kiwiply/ui (its Dockerfile + CI install workspace-aware from this root). The extension (job-autofill/) is still standalone; it joins when it renders the shared form (W3). Run `npm install` here to materialize the workspace.
